name: get_metadata
description: Return what this page holds: the number of paper links, where the data comes from, the facets (field, arxiv, topic, form, source, site) with their sizes, the search rules, and the page's own search, filters and selected link ids.

name: search_links
description: Search the paper links as the page's filter does: every word of text must occur in a link's title, note, site or tags (ignoring case), best matches first. Tags from one facet match any of them; facets must all match. With no text, tags or sites, every link in the order of the data. Does not change the page.

tags.description: Tag names, such as math.NT, modular-forms or lecture-notes (list_tags gives them)

sites.description: Site names, such as arxiv.org or github.com

name: get_link
description: Return one paper link by its id (1 is the first link of the data), with its BibTeX entry as the page exports it.

name: list_tags
description: Return the tags of each facet (field, arxiv, topic, form, source) and the sites (site), each with the number of links that have it, most used first.

name: export_bib
description: Return the .bib text that the page exports: for the given link ids (in the order of the data), or for every link that a search with text, tags and sites matches (best first). Keys, fields and escaping are those of the page's Download .bib.
